title: Wan2.2 Image to Video
description: Generate high-quality videos from a single image using Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B (27B MoE, 14B active). Supports 480P and 720P output with optional text-prompt guidance.

config.gpuIds: NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe,NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB,NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3,NVIDIA H100 NVL,NVIDIA H100 PCIe

input.name: Default Resolution
input.description: Default output resolution. Individual requests can override this via the 'resolution' input field.

input.name: Enable CPU Offload
input.description: Offload model layers to CPU RAM to lower peak GPU VRAM usage. Slower throughput but enables GPUs with less than 80GB VRAM.

input.name: HuggingFace Token
input.description: HuggingFace access token. Required only if using private or gated models.

input.name: S3 Bucket
input.description: Bucket for generated videos. Set this (with the key pair below) to receive a download URL instead of inline base64 — required for 720p, which exceeds RunPod's 10 MB payload cap.

input.name: S3 Endpoint URL
input.description: S3-compatible endpoint. Leave empty for AWS S3; set e.g. https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com for Cloudflare R2.

input.name: S3 Region
input.description: Bucket region. Use 'auto' for Cloudflare R2.

input.name: S3 Public URL Base
input.description: Public CDN base for the bucket, e.g. https://cdn.example.com. When set, videos are returned as permanent public URLs instead of expiring presigned links.

input.name: LoRA Directory
input.description: Directory holding .safetensors LoRA files, applied per request via the 'loras' input field. Point this at a mounted network volume.
